request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:MARKSMAN

layers.text: Change his clothes and skin: the red flying cap becomes an orange-brown leather flying cap, keeping the iron goggles; take off the red tunic so his chest, belly, arms and legs are bare skin; he wears a short orange-brown leather loincloth and a chest strap. The black bomb gets one band of hazard yellow and black stripes and a small red-orange spark. His skin a slightly darker true goblin green. Keep the face, ears, satchel, pose, proportions, black outline and art style the same.
